  > 
  > Your table request is already met by the current generators (your 292-line `tab2.tex` was the earlier version):
  > - `tab2.tex`: 26 lines, one block per design (largest-N dataset: Arena-55k, Athene-70B judge, MT-Bench human, NBA 1990), strata [1,2),[2,4),[4,8) plus one top-1 vs top-2 row. That was story-repo's acceptance; if you still prefer pooled judge/season blocks, say so and give the pooling rule.
  > - `tab2_full_delete.tex` / `tab2_full_flip.tex` (appendix, one per family; 134 lines each) and `tab5_full.tex` are now `{\footnotesize longtable}` groups: `\input` them outside a float, add `\usepackage{longtable}`. Compiled at 5.5 in, no overfull boxes. NBA seasons are not in the full table (they stay in `results/fragility_by_z.csv`).
  > - `tab1.tex` pools the judges and the NBA seasons ("(12)", "(44)" in the row label, ranges for N and models).
  > - Other tables (`tab1`, `tab2`, `tab3`, `tab4`, `tab5`) are `tabular` bodies at `\footnotesize`, no caption: put them in a float and do not rescale.
  > 
  > Figures, all vector, Type 42, 5.5 in wide: fig1 (two panels) 2.75 in; fig2 (equal-N) 2.2; fig3 2.31, `fig3_flip` is the flip-family version; fig4 about 3.4 (panel B is absent until `matched_contrasts.csv` exists; the figure then grows by one panel); fig5 (appendix) 4.36. Fig. 1A now plots, per dataset and z stratum, the real k* median with IQR against the null's k* at the same z (Outline rev 8); the pair's own gap does not enter it.
  > 
  > Caption facts: the grey band is exp(±0.15) read from `margins.json`, a visual guide on k*, not the decision rule (which applies to the interval of Δ on log Q). Fig. 1 counts: A has 191 strata (`strata_drawn_A`; 6 Arena crowd, 45 judge, 139 NBA, 1 MT-Bench), B has 2696 pairs. Fig. 3 intervals are Wilson over pairs (pairs treated as independent, so optimistic); Fig. 4 intervals are jackknife over models; Fig. 3A is % of N, 3B in SE units; `k*/k_best` is 1 for the winning method by construction; the NBA cost-2 row is 2 by construction.
